saved_arc_periodicity = await rlm.harness.create_memory(title='ARC periodic parallel stripe completion', content="""For ARC inputs made of parallel uniform stripes, complete the periodic pattern using stripe-line coordinates. Identify and ignore the background (often 0). Let P equal the number of foreground stripe lines, counting separate parallel line coordinates individually even if adjacent lines have the same color. A stripe at coordinate k assigns its color to phase k mod P; fill every line of the same orientation at that phase with the assigned color. Preserve the stripe orientation. For horizontal rows, k is the row index. For diagonal stripes in the demonstrated cases, k=r+c. Example: horizontal stripes at rows 0:4, 7:6, 9:2, 14:7 give P=4 and phases [0:4,1:2,2:7,3:6], so output rows repeat 4,2,7,6. Another horizontal example has background 0 and foreground rows 0:5, 2:2, 3:1, 4:9, 5:9, 6:9, 8:9; P=7, phases give [5,9,2,1,9,9,9], repeated. In that solved 9x9 test the 0 rows (1 and 7) were background, not foreground; count the seven nonzero rows to determine P.""", path='arc', global_=True)
